interface.longDescription: Build and use internal apps for your team inside ChatGPT. TrialAgents provides persistent data, documents, current app templates, custom interfaces, isolated JavaScript and saved functions. Reuse authorized data, preview completed changes and save within your approved permissions. Optional recurring research and email actions use scoped authorization and report their readiness separately. Connect a TrialAgents account to create and save apps. Not intended for patient-level data or regulated clinical decision-making.
